items.title: Teen Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Teens make the best hackers! Who else is up-to-date on the latest tech? Practice your hacking skills when you role-play in cool clothes and plenty of tech gear. Choose from lots of different skins and get busy causing trouble.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Spring Dreams
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Showers bring flowers, and bright new flowery fashions! Choose from 12 different skins and dress up in the latest floral outfits. Role-play as a terrific teen ready to step into spring. Enjoy the sunshine and colorful blooms that this splendid season brings.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Ninja Force
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Sneak around town and don’t get caught! Team up with other mysterious spies in dark ninja uniform. Making a fearsome force, role-play in martial arts experts skins, with swords! Lurk in the shadows and be ready to complete your top secret mission.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Nether Fashion
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
The latest nether trends are finally here, we guarantee you'll look absolutely fire!

+ 10 teens, bringing the ultimate nether fashion to your worlds!

items.title: Mob Monarchs
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Rule over the Minecraft world and impress your friends at the same time by decking yourself out with these super cool Mob Monarchs skins!

items.title: Hacker Masks HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Want to be a cool hacker teen that trolls their friends or owns players in PVP? Be an anonymous menace to all with these amazing masks and trendy fashion. Features neko, demon, dragon, ninja, bunny masks and more! Also includes a unique 101010 patterned skin for aesthetics.

+ 15 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Mech Armory
items.creator: Project Moonboot
items.description:
Mech suits are among us. Includes robots, motorcycle, industrial base and custom doors. 

- By Project Moonboot

items.title: Billionaire Furniture HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Live the billionaire lifestyle with 1024 HD Minecraft models! Have parties, play games, drive cars, be a celebrity, live it up! Includes plants, TVs, shelves and drawers, cool lights and more!
+Tools to change size, color, etc
+Cool sports cars
+64 unique models
+1024 textures/variants
+4 skins
+Mega mansion neighborhood

! Only usable with the world provided

items.title: Advanced Blimps
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
5 Frame Studios presents: Advanced Blimps! Get ready for an air or should we say helium-filled adventure! Advanced Blimps features 4 different blimps, 2 sportscars, a blimp port, and more!

- 4 different blimps.
- 2 sports cars.
- Great for roleplay!

- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: The Birch Persia Villa
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Overtales Studio presents: The Birch Persia Villa! Want to take a rest after a long journey in the wild? You have come to the right place! Explores this small but cozy village located in the middle of tall trees, throws away exhaustion and refuel yourself for another adventure.
- Roleplay
- Survival spawn
- Licensed by Overtales Studio and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Platform Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pixel Creations presents: Platform Base! Have you ever wondered how oil platforms work? Explore the main platform and three smaller ones. Drive custom boats around them like a real worker and enjoy the game.

- Four platforms.
- Underground base.
- Control room.
- Cinema.
- 6 HD skins.
- Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Glowing Glitches
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
There has been a glitch in the system! Pick any skin and break out of it along with your buddies. You can be stealthy or colorful!

- 8 skins
- 100% awesome
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Casual Attire Gamer
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Prepare your controllers, choose your favorite video games, and bring your friends to enjoy those fun and exciting weekends and holidays!

- 12 awesome skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Overtales Studio.

items.title: Royal Family
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
It's time to put on your crowns and tiaras! Rule from your castle with these fashionable royal skins! Do you have what it takes to become royalty and protect your kingdom?

- 10 skins!
- Perfect for role playing!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Enderman HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Ever wonder what Enderman do when they aren't picking up blocks and teleporting around? They go on adventures, build kingdoms, mine for treasure and live all sorts of lives! Roleplay as one of these fun Enderman characters!

items.title: Devils in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Fiendishly handsome, these devils are here to do business! Doesn't matter what you've been told its time to make a deal with a devil! Being lucky might not be enough to get you out of this contract!

- Includes 5 devilish fiends in suit skins!

items.title: Plasma Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
When physics goes awry these monsters are created! Grab your weapons and armor and see if you can block their strange, otherwordly attacks! Are you lucky enough to survive this cosmic onslaught?

- Includes ten cosmic plasma glitch skins!

items.title: Sharks in Suits
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These sharks are here to take a bite out of your bottom line and give a new meaning to an aggressive portfolio! From the beach to the office, they're bringing it to their competitors!

- Includes 10 jawesome sharks in suits skins!
- Includes 10 variants wearing sunglasses!

items.title: Toxic Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Born from the pollution of the seas and sky, these horrors are here for revenge! Grab your weapons and build your defenses! Are you lucky enough to stand against their onslaught and block their venomous attacks?

- Includes ten poisonous toxic glitch skins!

items.title: Neon Neko Teens
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Ready to become the best modern neon neko character around? If so, choose between these 20 awesome anime inspired neko outfits that show off your bright cat features which will rock the city!

- 20 teen skins
- Modern and fun
- Includes 2 free skins

items.title: Rainbow Fashion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens are dressed up in the latest rainbow fashion to date! Perfect if you want to stand out from the crowds!

- 12 different colorful designs!
- With a wide variety of skins, you can find the perfect one to represent you!

items.title: Jailbreak!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Police, sound the alarms! These criminals have just busted out of jail and are on the run!

- 12 different skins!
- Wide variety of designs so you can find the perfect skin that represents you!

items.title: Advanced Skyblock
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Ready to upgrade your skyblock experience and put your survival knowledge to the test? In this fun modern skyblock map, you can explore 4 islands that are designed around the end, the Nether, overworld, and ocean that all have custom villagers!

+ 4 large islands
+ 8 teen skins
+ Starting loot

items.title: Teddy Teens
items.creator: TNTgames
items.description: Dress up as cute teddy bears with Teddy Teens!
